Keep the full square transparent canvas and exact position/scale from image 2: this layer must align with other independent pieces. Render ONLY the isolated Hero hat / teacup piece shown in image 2. Do not add any surrounding body, face, limbs, hair or other costume pieces. Preserve transparent gaps. Output a single square PNG with real alpha transparency; do not crop, zoom, trim or recenter.
